title: Nudge on iOS Booking Detail
lede: Staff looking at an overdue checkout on their phone can now remind the borrower without switching to the web dashboard.

sections.heading: Overdue checkout, staff view
sections.note: Same fixture, device, appearance and scroll. The baseline was captured from an isolated HEAD worktree with only the fixture and test harness files copied in; BookingDetailView and APIClient are the pre-change source. Clock is relative to launch, so the minute shown differs by one.

pairs.title: Bottom action bar
pairs.sub: Volleyball vs Nebraska, two hours overdue.
pairs.beforeCap: Extend was the only action. Reminding the borrower meant opening the web dashboard.
pairs.afterCap: Nudge sits beside Extend, in red to match the overdue state.

sections.heading: After a tap
sections.note: After-only: the baseline has no Nudge to tap. Captured in the same UI test run against the fixture's stubbed nudge route.

shots.title: Nudge sent with history
shots.cap: Green Nudge Sent plus the shared history line ("Nudged just now by …"). Colleagues opening this booking within the hour see the same line and a sent button.

changes.was: Only the web dashboard's overdue banner could send a nudge; the iOS app had no call to the nudge route.
changes.now: Booking Detail shows Nudge for an open, past-due checkout when the server grants the nudge action. That hides it from Students and from shared travel-case checkouts.
The button shows a spinner while sending, then a green Nudge Sent confirmation, and ignores further taps. Failures, including the server's return grace period, show inline under the booking.

changes.h: Nobody could see who already nudged
changes.was: The sent state lived in one screen's memory; a reload or a second staff member saw a fresh Nudge button.
changes.now: Dashboard overdue rows and booking detail read the latest nudge from the audit log: "Nudged 20m ago by Erik". Within the hour the button shows as sent. Shared travel-case checkouts no longer offer Nudge on the web banner.

verification: BookingNudgeScreenshotUITests.testOverdueNudgeCaptures passed on the iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator: Nudge rendered, the tap reached the sent state.
Baseline testOverdueNudgeBaselineCaptures passed in the isolated worktree.
Wisconsin simulator build succeeded; tests/ios-booking-nudge-contract.test.ts passes (3 tests).
tests/nudge-history.test.ts (6) plus the full vitest suite: 700 files pass after updating two Extend-label contracts.
notes: Fixture captures prove presentation only. Not verified: a real nudge against the API as Staff, push delivery to the borrower, or the grace-period error on a device.
Home still lists only the viewer's own checkouts; staff reach this screen from Bookings or the Overdue report.
The web overdue banner change was not browser-verified; it needs an authenticated dev:preview session with an overdue checkout.
